enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Sleep. Stretch legs. Turn on back. Sleep. Snore softly. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Take bowl to sink. Rinse bowl. Put bowl in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes from shoe rack. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Put stethoscope in bag. Put water bottle in bag. Put lunch in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work (public transport)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient list. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check blood pressure. Administer medication. Record data. Walk to nurse station.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital (public transport)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom. Put on clean clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Take plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Sweep floor. Put broom away. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Put drink on table. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Scrolling on phone and watching TV to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Watch TV. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Pick up phone again. Scroll. Set phone alarm. Put phone on charger. Turn off TV.
Turn off light. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
